description: Eight-step sequential switch, gate generator and step sequencer: one signal routed to or from eight jacks under a clock, with a gain and a gate on every step

params.text: Starts and stops the sequence: pushed up it plays and a second push stops it, pushed down it resets and plays one cycle through
Picks which step the switch is on, one step per position; turned fully anti-clockwise to RUN, the step advances with the clock instead
Sets what the gate outputs do on each step: no gate, one gate filling the step, one gate at 50% duty, or between 2 and 8 gates spread through the step
Multiplies or divides the clock driving the sequence, from a sixteenth of the incoming rate up to sixteen times it
Attenuates the signal passing through the switch on that step, from silence to unity gain

inputs.text: Sets how many gates each step carries, a volt per gate up to 10V, with the GATE MODE knob attenuating it
Selects the step, a volt per step, added to the ADDRESS knob
The clock driving the sequence, read high above 2V and low below 0.1V; with nothing patched an internal clock runs instead, set by tap tempo on the menu
A rising edge sends the playhead back to the start; from stopped it also plays one cycle through
In 1 input to 8 outputs mode, the signal routed out to whichever step is current
In 8 inputs to 1 output mode, this step's signal, passed to the COM output while the step is current and scaled by that step's gain slider
A signal normalled into every step jack that has no cable of its own; with nothing patched here it stands at 10V, which the menu can change to 1V or 5V

outputs.text: A 10V clock, multiplied or divided from the incoming clock by its own setting on the menu
A 10V gate whenever the current step's gate is high, so it carries the gate pattern of every step in turn
A 1ms 10V pulse when the eighth step ends
A 10V gate on that step, following the pattern the GATE MODE knob sets, and silent while the sequence is stopped
In 1 input to 8 outputs mode, the COM signal scaled by that step's gain slider while the step is current, and 0V the rest of the time
In 8 inputs to 1 output mode, the current step's input scaled by that step's gain slider
In 1 input to 8 outputs mode, the COM signal scaled by the current step's gain slider, carried here whenever that step's own output has no cable

notes: the sequence comes up stopped. Push the PLAY switch up to start it, and turn the ADDRESS knob fully anti-clockwise to RUN, or the step will not advance with the clock.
menu: 1 input ▸ 8 outputs — makes the COM jack an input and the eight step jacks outputs; the jacks change colour to show it, and the cables on them are cleared
Input clock — multiplies or divides the incoming clock before the sequencer counts it
Quadratic only mode — limits the clock multiplications and divisions and the gate counts to powers of two; off by default
Output clock follows play/stop — silences the clock output whenever the sequence is stopped; off by default
8 inputs ▸ 1 output — makes the eight step jacks inputs and the COM jack an output; the jacks change colour to show it, and the cables on them are cleared
Output clock — multiplies or divides the clock sent to the clock output
Tap to set internal tempo... — sets the internal clock from the gaps between clicks, and appears only while nothing is patched into the clock input
All In Normalled Value — sets what the step jacks fall back to when the ALL input has no cable: 1V, 5V or 10V; it can only be reached in 8 inputs ▸ 1 output mode, and is greyed out otherwise

inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
